overview.description: The Principal Securitized Debt ETF (WDE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed ETF investing across the securitized debt sectors. It uses fundamental, technical, and valuation methods to select securities. WDE was launched on May 21, 2026 and is issued by Principal.
